description: Payment UX cluster: real PromptPay QR rendering (1A), mock payment auto-confirm/reconcile (2C), and the payment-channel settings screen that binds the PromptPay id into the QR (3D). Depends on FEAT-001 because it edits the same PaymentScreen payment flow.
steps: Install QR libs compatible with Expo ~51 / RN 0.74.5: react-native-svg at the Expo-51 SDK-pinned version (15.2.0) and react-native-qrcode-svg (pin an exact compatible version). Verify they resolve for react-native-web. Record the chosen versions in the commit message and in this FEAT's findings.

In src/screens/sale/PaymentScreen.tsx QR modal: replace the placeholder Ionicons qr-code + 'generate จาก Payment Gateway' text with a real QR. Call paymentApi.generateOfflineQR(amountDue) (import paymentApi from src/services/api/paymentApi.ts) and render the payload via react-native-qrcode-svg. Show merchant PromptPay id + amount below the QR. Keep the manual 'ยืนยันการชำระ' button.

2C auto-confirm: import FEATURE_FLAGS. When MOCK_PAYMENT_AUTOCONFIRM is true and the QR modal opens, start a 3-5s timer (// MOCK:) that flips payment state to success ('ชำระสำเร็จ') and auto-closes/confirms the bill via the existing confirm path. Clear the timer on modal close/unmount. When the flag is off, leave a commented else branch that would poll paymentApi.checkStatus. The manual confirm button remains a fallback in both cases.

3D payment-channel settings: extend the existing SettingPaymentSection in src/screens/web/WebSimpleScreens.tsx (web, WebColors + tokens) to enter PromptPay id / bank account, toggle & reorder channels, with Thai labels, loading/error/empty states. Persist to a store — reuse storeConfigStore (add promptPayId/bankAccount/channel fields) or add src/store/paymentConfigStore.ts (zustand+persist, name 'pos-payment-config').

Bind the configured PromptPay id into the QR: have PaymentScreen read the id from the payment-config store and pass it to a QR generator that uses it (either add an overload paymentApi.generatePromptPayQR(id, amount) call with the stored id, or make generateOfflineQR accept an optional id). Fall back to ENV.PROMPTPAY_ID when unset.
acceptance_criteria: react-native-svg + react-native-qrcode-svg are in package.json at Expo-51-compatible pinned versions (documented in findings).
PaymentScreen QR modal renders a scannable QR from the EMVCo payload plus the merchant PromptPay id and amount; manual confirm button still present.
With MOCK_PAYMENT_AUTOCONFIRM on, the QR flow auto-confirms after ~3-5s and closes the bill; with it off the manual button is used; the timer is cleaned up.
A payment-channel settings screen lets the user set a PromptPay id that is persisted and encoded into the generated QR (ENV fallback when unset).
verification: npm run lint (no new tsc errors beyond baseline 13)
findings:
QR LIBS: pinned exactly (--save-exact) react-native-svg@15.2.0 (Expo SDK-51 pin) + react-native-qrcode-svg@6.3.2. npm install clean, NO peer-dep errors; qrcode-svg 6.3.x has a broad react-native-svg peer range compatible with 15.x and works on react-native-web. package.json now lists both as exact (no ^/~).
PAYMENTAPI (src/services/api/paymentApi.ts): generateOfflineQR now takes an optional 2nd arg -> generateOfflineQR(amount, promptPayId?); uses promptPayId?.trim() || ENV.PROMPTPAY_ID. generatePromptPayQR unchanged.
NEW STORE (src/store/paymentConfigStore.ts): zustand+persist, name 'pos-payment-config', persistStorage. State: promptPayId, bankAccount, bankName, accountName, channels: PaymentChannel[] (id/label/icon/color/enabled) seeded with 6 defaults (cash/qr/transfer/credit/wallet/coupon). Actions: setPromptPayId/setBankAccount/setBankName/setAccountName, toggleChannel, moveChannel(id,'up'|'down'), addChannel, removeChannel, setChannels. Exported getPaymentConfig() non-hook accessor + PaymentChannel interface.
PAYMENTSCREEN (src/screens/sale/PaymentScreen.tsx): (1A) imports QRCode from react-native-qrcode-svg, paymentApi, FEATURE_FLAGS, ENV, usePaymentConfigStore. Reads promptPayId via usePaymentConfigStore((s)=>s.promptPayId); effectivePromptPayId = promptPayId || ENV.PROMPTPAY_ID; qrAmount = remaining>0?remaining:grandTotal; qrPayload = useMemo(generateOfflineQR(qrAmount, effectivePromptPayId)). QR modal now renders <QRCode value={qrPayload} size={200}/> inside a white framed box + 'พร้อมเพย์ {id}' + amount hint (replaced the Ionicons qr-code placeholder + 'generate จาก Payment Gateway' text). (2C) new state qrStatus('idle'|'success') + autoConfirmTimer ref. openQRModal(): when FEATURE_FLAGS.MOCK_PAYMENT_AUTOCONFIRM is true, // MOCK: setTimeout 4s -> qrStatus='success' -> 0.8s -> closeQRModal()+confirmQRPayment(); when flag off leaves a commented paymentApi.checkStatus polling else-branch. closeQRModal() + useEffect(()=>clearAutoConfirmTimer,[]) clean up the timer on close/unmount. Manual 'ลูกค้าสแกนแล้ว — ยืนยัน' button kept as fallback in BOTH flag states (calls closeQRModal+confirmQRPayment). confirmQRPayment builds a Payment{method:'qr',amount:grandTotal} and runs the shared confirm path. handleConfirmPayment refactored to accept optional overridePayments (uses finalPayments/finalPaid) so the timer can confirm without relying on component payments state; SaleRecord receives finalPayments/finalPaid. (3D binding) QR encodes the configured PromptPay id with ENV fallback.
SETTINGS 3D (src/screens/web/WebSimpleScreens.tsx SettingPaymentSection): now driven by usePaymentConfigStore instead of local useState. Added a 'บัญชีรับเงิน (PromptPay QR)' card: PromptPay id input (validated: digits only, 10 or 13 length), bank name/account/account-name inputs, save button with ActivityIndicator loading + '✓ บันทึกแล้ว' + inline error state (Alert-style row). Channel list gains up/down reorder chevrons (moveChannel) alongside existing toggle/add/remove, plus an empty-state card. Added ActivityIndicator to the RN import. Thai labels throughout, WebColors + design-system tokens.
VERIFICATION (from worktree): npm install OK; npm run lint = 13 baseline tsc errors, NO new (none in changed files); npm test = 14 cartAdapter tests pass + only the 3 baseline suite-load failures (engine.test.ts, SyncService.test.ts, branchPermissionStore.test.ts); npx tsx engine self-test Passed:39 Failed:0.
